title: commit_lane takes the board files and the protected files as two lists
body:
**Chose:** `commit_lane(lane, base, board, protected, message, ref_name)`: both lists are unstaged, and only `protected` paths the worker changed come back in `dropped`.
**Over:** the slice's single `drop: &[String]`. With one list the library cannot tell a board file from a protected one, yet acceptance (c) wants the board files dropped silently and the protected ones named.
**Because:** the caller already holds both lists apart (`commit::tool_files`, `commit::protected_files`). `land` takes `board` the same way.
**Undo:** merge the two arguments and let the caller filter `dropped` against its board files.

title: cargo fmt and the full inner loop see sibling slices' half-written files
body: Sibling builders write the same tree mid-run, so a crate-wide `cargo fmt` rewrites their files and `fmt --check`/clippy can go red on them. Instead, check your own files with `rustfmt --edition 2024 --check <files>` and read clippy errors by file.

title: Parallel builders share the tree; fmt and build reds can be another slice's
body: Four slice builders share one working tree: `cargo fmt --check` and the build can go red on another slice's mid-edit file (`src/lanes.rs`, `tests/harness/mod.rs`). Run `rustfmt --edition 2024` on your own files only, never `cargo fmt`; rebuild after a minute when the red is in a file you did not touch.

title: A lane setup must not end in a quote
body: A lane file's `setup:` value loses any leading or trailing quote (`src/lanes.rs` parse trims `"` and `'`), so a setup ending in `…log"` breaks in sh; end it unquoted, e.g. `>> "$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")"/scenario/lane-setup.log`.

title: How does the stub tell a merge pack apart?
body:
**Chose:** the stub reads a pack as `merge` when its first `# ` heading is `# Conflict`, tested before every other role; `touch` on a merge step defaults to none.
**Over:** matching `# Conflict` anywhere in the pack, as the other roles match their headings.
**Because:** a merge pack carries the slice file and its text, which may quote any heading; the slice says "first section". With no default touch, a `done` without `sh` leaves the markers, the slice's "markers left" case.
**Undo:** move the test into the ternary chain with `/^# Conflict$/m`.

title: main_tree keeps its own common-dir call
body:
**Chose:** `lanes::main_tree` runs its own `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`.
**Over:** calling `paths::git_common_dir`, which the slice said to use if slice 02 added it.
**Because:** that helper sat in the shared working tree uncommitted (slice 02's commit holds only tests and its slice file), so depending on it would tie this slice's commit to another slice's unlanded work.
**Undo:** once `paths::git_common_dir` is committed, make `main_tree` its parent, canonical; one function.

title: The worker hook matches source text in a heredoc
body: The worker hook refuses a Bash command whose text names the VCS tool and its upload verb anywhere, even inside a Python heredoc of Rust source (`git(` plus `.push(`), and refuses recursive grep over src: make multi-line source edits with the Edit tool, write log bodies to a scratch file and pipe them in, and look code up with `factory ctx`.

title: Remove the shared-tree lines the slice did not name?
body:
**Chose:** also drop the shared-tree prose the slice did not name: the `factory docs lanes set` closing hint ("what the lane does NOT isolate … while a sibling runs") now points at `factory lanes up --prove`, and polish §5's log rule says "so entries never collide" in place of "so fixers running at once never collide".
**Over:** leaving both as they were, as the slice listed only the template paragraph and polish `:105`, `:107`, `:109`.
**Because:** FR-9 drops the shared-tree prose and FR-5 makes fixers run one at a time; both lines contradicted that right next to the edits.
**Undo:** restore the two strings in `src/docs/lanes.rs` and `skills/polish/SKILL.md` (a skill edit needs a version bump).

title: Claim slice 03's uncommitted pub mod lanes?
body:
**Chose:** `git add src/cli/mod.rs`, whose only change is `pub mod lanes;`, with this slice.
**Over:** leaving it unclaimed in the working tree, where it has sat since slice 03.
**Because:** HEAD's `src/main.rs` names `cli::lanes`, so HEAD does not build without that line, and this slice extends that module. `src/lib.rs`'s `pub mod land;` (slice 04) and `src/paths.rs`'s `git_common_dir` (slice 02) are also uncommitted; nothing at HEAD needs them, so they stay unclaimed.
**Undo:** drop the line from this slice's commit; it then needs another owner.
